conditions.render: DX11 offscreen 1280x800, actual depth/RGB-D cameras; screen percentage 75, shadow/postprocess quality 1
conditions.functional_clock: benchmark fixed 30 FPS input, bounded physics at >=960 Hz; actual wall-clock speed reported separately
conditions.model: existing reduced directional-contact mecanum model; detailed rollers remain an option, not qualified here
conditions.inventory_support: Actual static rack impulse plus no recent support from any vehicle parts; target reservation never proves placement
conditions.perception: Measured GPU depth, known-family geometric template, measured ranges/presence/load and encoder/IMU tracking. No actor poses or IDs in recognition input
conditions.localization: Known initial bays + encoder/IMU + LiDAR registration against authored static survey; reports unavailable fixes explicitly

known_limits: Three-vehicle real-time performance is not qualified by fixed-step functional tests. Actual FPS/sim-wall ratios remain visible and performance tuning is part of group 6.
Open warehouse areas can lose surveyed-map observability at the current LiDAR range. Route-wide localization coverage and reference/range design must be validated when connecting group 5.
Inactive shelf stock stays instanced/static until selected; manipulable stock is promoted without duplicate collision.
Geometry and material/mass parameters are design assumptions; not a manufacturer load rating or real-equipment calibration.
The campus does not publish mixed vehicle frames to the existing single-vehicle dashboard; group 6 will add vehicle-keyed telemetry.

interactive_launch.startup_log_note: Three LogAutomationTest Condition failed entries occurred before engine initialization, also present in the final test process; the actual Forklift unit report records 92 passed, 0 failed, 0 not-run. Editor map loaded and remained responding.
